urls.name: Airtel
urls.description: Airtel is an Indian telecommunications provider offering mobile voice and data plans, 4G and 5G connectivity, broadband and fixed-line services, and business connectivity solutions.
use_cases: Recharge an Airtel prepaid number or pay a postpaid bill.
Compare mobile plans and check data, calling and roaming benefits.
Check Airtel mobile network coverage or explore home broadband.
Find customer support and business connectivity information.

urls.name: Jio
urls.description: Jio provides mobile and fixed broadband connectivity in India, including 4G and 5G mobile services, JioFiber and JioAirFiber home internet, and digital and enterprise connectivity services.
use_cases: Recharge a Jio number or manage a mobile connection.
Check 4G or 5G coverage and compare mobile plans.
Explore JioFiber or JioAirFiber home internet options.
Access account support and business connectivity services.

urls.name: Vi
urls.description: Vi (Vodafone Idea) is an Indian mobile network operator providing prepaid and postpaid voice and data services, 4G and expanding 5G connectivity, and mobile solutions for consumers and businesses.
use_cases: Recharge a Vi prepaid number or pay a postpaid bill.
Compare voice, data and roaming plans.
Check Vi 4G or 5G availability in an area.
Get help with a SIM, account or business mobile service.

urls.name: BSNL
urls.description: Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL) is a Government of India-owned telecommunications company providing mobile, landline, broadband and other communication services across India.
use_cases: Recharge a BSNL mobile connection or manage its account.
Explore BSNL Bharat Fiber broadband and landline services.
Find plans, service information and customer support.
Check available BSNL telecom services for a home or business.

urls.name: TRAI
urls.description: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) is the statutory regulator for telecommunications in India. Its website provides regulatory information, consumer resources, service-quality information, consultation papers, recommendations and complaint-redressal guidance.
use_cases: Understand consumer rights and complaint-redressal routes for telecom services.
Find telecom service-provider and network coverage information.
Read regulations, consultation papers and recommendations.
Review service-quality and tariff-related regulatory information.

urls.name: DoT
urls.description: The Department of Telecommunications (DoT), under the Government of India’s Ministry of Communications, handles central government policy, licensing and administration matters relating to telecommunications, spectrum and communication networks.
use_cases: Find official telecom policies, rules, notifications and government updates.
Access DoT citizen-facing services and telecom-related guidance.
Review information about telecom licensing and spectrum administration.
Locate departmental contacts, public notices and grievance information.
